title: Free Night Awards Brand Standard: Earning, Elite Credit and Fees on Award Nights
content:
On a night paid with any of the Free Night Awards, the hotel treats points earning, elite night credit, elite benefits and the resort fee as set out below. The treatment is the same for all six award types: 25K, 35K, 40K, 50K and 85K Free Night Award and Any Hotel Free Night Award.

| On the award night | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Points on the room | Not earned |
| Points on eligible incidentals charged during the award stay | Earned |
| Elite night credit | The award night counts as an elite night credit |
| Elite on-property benefits | Apply |
| Resort fee | Not charged |

### Front desk notes

- The room portion of an award night earns no points, while eligible incidentals the guest charges during the award stay earn points.
- The award night counts toward the member's elite night credits like any other night credited.
- The member's elite on-property benefits apply on the award night.
- No resort fee is charged on an award night, including at brands whose hotels charge a resort fee on other nights.

### Hypothetical stay

A hypothetical one-night award stay with an eligible restaurant charge on the folio: the room night earns no points, the restaurant charge earns points, the night counts as one elite night credit, and no resort fee is posted for the award night.
